description: Address review findings: remove dead reload.onConfigChange field, simplify agent-active state transition in run gate, fix hook handler arity mismatch, make Ollama snapshot fields nullable, add advisory-only comment to run gate.
steps: Remove the reload.onConfigChange field from definePluginEntry in index.ts. Remove the __gpuBroker monkeypatch. Add a comment that config changes require gateway restart until a proper reload mechanism is implemented.

Simplify the run gate: remove the enterAgentActive() call from createRunGate so the gate only checks canAgentRun() without transitioning states. Keep enterAgentActive/exitAgentActive methods on the broker class for future use. Update index.ts to not rely on state transition in the gate.
Fix the before_model_resolve hook handler in index.ts to accept (_event, _ctx) parameters instead of empty args.
Update GpuSnapshot type to use null for totalMb and freeMb when data is unavailable. Update snapshotViaOllama to return null for those fields instead of 0.
Add a code comment to the run gate documenting the advisory-only nature of the gate.

Update tests to reflect changes: fix run-gate.test.ts to not expect state transitions, fix index.test.ts to remove reload.onConfigChange test, update degradation tests if needed for nullable snapshot fields.
acceptance_criteria: No reload.onConfigChange field in the plugin entry
Run gate does not call enterAgentActive()
GpuSnapshot uses null for totalMb and freeMb when Ollama-only
Run gate has advisory-only documentation comment
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/creative-claw && npx vitest run --project extensions extensions/gpu-broker
findings: All 54 tests pass after fixes. Removed reload.onConfigChange dead code and __gpuBroker monkeypatch. Simplified run gate to only check canAgentRun() without driving state transitions. Fixed hook handler arity to (_event, _ctx). Changed GpuSnapshot.totalMb and freeMb to number|null, Ollama path now returns null instead of 0. Added advisory-only documentation to run gate. The enterAgentActive/exitAgentActive methods remain on the broker class for future use.
